params.prompt: Photorealistic restaurant menu drink photograph, 3/4 angle. A galvanized metal tub filled with crushed ice holding assorted glass-bottle sodas in bright colors: orange, lime green, dark cola, pink grapefruit. Plain unlabeled bottles with plain metal caps, water droplets on the glass. One opened bottle stands beside the tub. The food sits on the red-painted wooden counter of a walk-up food stand in Los Angeles. Bright natural afternoon sunlight with crisp soft shadows, 50mm lens, shallow depth of field; background softly blurred warm red and brick tones with a hint of colorful cut-paper banners. Tack-sharp focus, true-to-life textures and natural color, appetizing but not over-styled. No text, no logos, no labels, no people, no hands.
